verdict.rationale: Teller documents a payments resource for sending money to the user or a third party from their connected account, with idempotent requests [teller-docs-5][teller-docs-18][teller-docs-20]. However, Zelle is the only supported scheme, so this is a narrow rail rather than a general pay-by-bank product. The docs also never state the live geographies; the founder's 'cannot move money' remark comes from an older UK-era thread and does not contradict the current payments docs. Missing for 10: live geographies stated explicitly, payment rails beyond Zelle (e.g. ACH or RTP initiation), documented payment status and lifecycle handling, independent or hands-on corroboration of payments working.
